name: pubmed-ncbi
description: PubMed (NCBI biomedical literature database): search articles by keyword, author or field-tagged query, with filters, sorting and pagination, and fetch full abstract records, MEDLINE text exports and PMID lists. All commands read the server-rendered search page.

commands.name: search-articles
commands.summary: Search PubMed articles by keyword or field-tagged query with optional filters, sort, author ID and pagination; returns summary results (PMID, title, authors, citation, snippet)

params.name: term
params.description: Search query. Accepts plain keywords and PubMed field tags, e.g. 'crispr', 'Hryhorowicz M', '"Nature"[jour] AND crispr', '31727474[pmid] OR 36163606[pmid]'

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. relevance=Best match (the default when omitted), date=Most recent, pubdate=Publication date, fauth=First author, jour=Journal

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort direction, used with sort=pubdate/fauth/jour

params.name: filter
params.description: Result filter. Examples: datesearch.y_1, datesearch.y_5, datesearch.y_10 (last 1/5/10 years); years.2020-2025 (custom year range); simsearch1.fha (has abstract); simsearch2.ffrft (free full text); pub

params.name: filter2
params.description: Second filter to combine with the first. Same values as --filter

params.name: filter3
params.description: Third filter to combine with the others. Same values as --filter

params.name: cauthor_id
params.description: Computed author ID. Use it with an author-name term to restrict results to one disambiguated author, e.g. term='Hryhorowicz M' cauthor_id=27699445

params.name: page
params.description: Results page number, starting at 1

params.name: size
params.description: Results per page

commands.name: get-articles
commands.summary: Get full article records (title, authors, affiliations, PMID/PMCID/DOI, journal, abstract, full-text links) for a query, typically a list of PMIDs; this replaces the blocked article detail pages

params.name: term
params.description: Query whose results are shown as full records. For specific articles join PMIDs with OR, e.g. '31727474[pmid] OR 36163606[pmid]'. Any search query also works

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance, date (most recent), pubdate, fauth (first author), jour (journal)

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional result filter, e.g. simsearch2.ffrft, pubt.review, datesearch.y_5, years.2020-2025

params.name: page
params.description: Results page number, starting at 1

params.name: size
params.description: Records per page

commands.name: export-medline
commands.summary: Export search results as plain-text MEDLINE/PubMed records (all tagged fields: PMID, TI, AB, AU, AD, MH, DP, etc.)

params.name: term
params.description: Search query or PMID list, e.g. 'crispr' or '31727474[pmid] OR 36163606[pmid]'

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance, date, pubdate, fauth, jour

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional result filter, e.g. simsearch2.ffrft, pubt.review, datesearch.y_5

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1

params.name: size
params.description: Records per page

commands.name: list-pmids
commands.summary: Get only the PMIDs that match a search query, as a plain list (up to 200 per page); a cheap way to collect IDs for get-articles

params.name: term
params.description: Search query, e.g. 'crispr' or '"Nature"[jour] AND crispr'

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance, date, pubdate, fauth, jour

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort direction for pubdate/fauth/jour

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional result filter, e.g. simsearch2.ffrft, pubt.review, datesearch.y_5, years.2020-2025

params.name: filter2
params.description: Second filter to combine with the first. Same values as --filter

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1

params.name: size
params.description: PMIDs per page

notes: Every command reads the server-rendered search page https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=...; the format parameter (summary/abstract/pubmed/pmid) picks the output. No login is needed.
Article detail pages (/{pmid}/), cited-by listings, /{pmid}/citations/ and /suggestions/ return 403 for this client. Use get-articles with PMID field tags instead.

A query that matches exactly one article (e.g. a single PMID) makes PubMed redirect to the blocked detail page. To fetch one article, OR its PMID with another, or use export-medline. Some single-hit queries may still fail.
Field tags work inside term: [pmid], [jour], [au], [ti], [tiab], [dp], [mh]. Combine them with AND/OR/NOT.
To combine filters, pass --filter, --filter2 and --filter3; each one is sent as its own repeated 'filter' query parameter.
To search one disambiguated author, set term to the author name and add cauthor_id (e.g. 'Hryhorowicz M' and 27699445). Sorting by date is typical.
export-medline and list-pmids return the text block shown on the page. Split the MEDLINE output on blank lines between records and the PMID list on newlines.
The alerts.json endpoint on cdn.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov only carries site banner notices and is not exposed as a command.
